title: Logarithmic bias support identity
statement:
Let $n,d$ be natural numbers and let $[0m\varepsilon>0$, with $n>0$. Define $b=(\varepsilon/9)^{2^{d-1}}$, where $d-1$ is truncated natural subtraction. Then
\[\log_2\!\left(16\left(\frac{n}{b}\right)^2\right)=4+2\left(\log_2 n+2^{d-1}\log_2\!\left(\frac{9}{\varepsilon}\right)\right).\]
